_note: Copy for the SledPack concept film v2 (SIM-034, user decisions 2026-10-21). Numbers only from dev/promo_facts.json (sledpack@0.2.0 / I10). Untested behaviour is phrased as a design goal/concept. Re-render text only: python3 sim/tools/render_promo.py --v2 --stage text --keep

tag.zh: 概念可视化 · 仿真渲染 · 未经实物验证
tag.en: Concept visualisation · simulated render · not physically tested

sub.zh: 背在背上的跟拍风筝 · 概念
sub.en: A follow-cam kite you wear on your back · concept

example.en: Skiing is just the example in this film

title.zh: 没有杆子。风筝就趴在背上。
title.en: No pole. The kite rides on your back.

sub.zh: 不用折叠收纳：张开的软翼风筝直接贴在背上
sub.en: Nothing to fold away: the open soft kite rides flat on your back

title.zh: 张开的风筝贴在背上；动力都在腰包里
title.en: The open kite rides on your back; everything powered sits at the hip

kiteOnBack.zh: 张开的雪橇风筝，机头朝上贴在背上
kiteOnBack.en: Open sled kite, nose up, lying on your back

seat.zh: 肩带上的磁吸座卡住两根翼杆
seat.en: Magnetic seats on the straps hold the two keels

lumbar.en: Lumbar module: two-drum reel, battery, electronics

mouth.zh: 出线环在臀后约 15 cm 的可折平短片上，环可脱开（不是杆；摔倒/坐下时的风险待评估）
mouth.en: Line eyelet on a ≈15 cm fold-flat hip-belt tab with a breakaway ring (not a pole; fall/sitting risk not yet assessed)

title.zh: 设计目标：蹬出去，它就知道
title.en: Designed to know when you push off

sub.zh: 惯导 + 卫星定位判定滑行（仿真设想，未实测）
sub.en: IMU + GNSS to confirm you are skiing (simulated concept, not tested)

note.zh: 示意界面 · 数值为剧本示意

law._note: line schedule shown in the HUD graph (promo_facts I10); the 3D kite and HUD line readout follow sim/js/promo2/timeline.js GEOM — a cap change needs a 3D re-render too

title.zh: 设计设想：直接从背上放飞
title.en: Concept: launches straight off your back

sub.zh: 磁扣松开，风筝约 0.8 s 从背上剥离，先落进身后尾流，放线进入干净气流后爬升（仿真中约 2 s 开始拍；从背上脱离和尾流为假设模型）
sub.en: The seats release, the kite peels off your back in ≈0.8 s, drops into the wake and climbs once paid out into clean air (filming after ≈2 s in simulation; release from the back and the wake are assumed models)

title.zh: 滑得越快、风越大，放得越远（因此越高）
title.en: Faster and windier: farther out, and so higher

sub.zh: 线长随相对风 5–9 m（约 4–7.5 m 高），仰角保持约 55°（仿真中的控制规律）
sub.en: Line 5–9 m with the apparent wind (≈4–7.5 m up) at about the same 55° angle (control law in simulation)

label.zh: 机载视角 · 仿真渲染，非实拍
label.en: Onboard view · simulated render, not real footage

sub.zh: 吊舱相机顺着线看向你
sub.en: The pod camera looks down the line at you

title.zh: 风小或顺风：更近、更低；顺风大时不飞
title.en: Light air or tailwind: closer and lower — or not at all

sub.zh: 线收到 5 m；顺风超过约 5 m/s 就留在背上不放飞
sub.en: The line comes in to 5 m; above ≈5 m/s tailwind it stays on your back

title.en: Slow down: it depowers and is pulled low

sub.zh: 帆像旗一样塌下，趁人还在滑立即拉低，设计上避免它飘过头顶（仿真最近 0.49 m）
sub.en: The sail flags and is pulled down while you still slide, designed to keep it from drifting over your head (closest 0.49 m in simulation)

title.zh: 有时它能自己回到背上
title.en: Sometimes it lays itself back onto your back

sub.zh: 只在线从身后收回时——仿真中约每 10 次停下 1 次；其余时候在雪面待机。收工时手动拿起（约 20 s）
sub.en: Only when the line comes in from behind — about 1 stop in 10 in simulation; otherwise it parks on the snow. End of run: pick it up by hand (≈20 s)

sub.zh: 没有杆，没有要折叠的东西；也可以手动卷起放进背包（约 2.5 L，可选）
sub.en: No pole, nothing to fold; optionally roll it up by hand into a pack (≈2.5 L)

title.zh: 仿真中达标的项目与设计估算
title.en: Passing in simulation, plus design estimates

label.zh: 全套背负质量（设计估算）
放飞成功率（假设的背上脱离与尾流模型）
label.en: Launch success (assumed release-from-back and wake models)

label.zh: 线/风筝离头盔中心最近，不接触（仿真 0.49 m；每次靠近 ≤1.9 s；取决于尾流/脱离模型）
label.en: Closest line/kite to the helmet centre, no contact (0.49 m in simulation; each close pass ≤1.9 s; depends on wake/release models)

label.zh: 对身体的最大拉力（限值 40 N；取决于尾流模型）
label.en: Peak pull on the body (limit 40 N; depends on the wake model)

label.zh: −10 °C 拍摄续航（中级滑雪者；高手速度约 37 min）
label.en: Filming at −10 °C (intermediate rider; ≈37 min at expert speeds)

label.zh: 最大撞击动能（限值 14.9 J；15–17 m/s 高手速度时超限）
label.en: Peak strike energy (limit 14.9 J; fails for 15–17 m/s riders)

footnote.zh: 数值来自未经标定的数值仿真（48 种风况、一种中级滑雪者速度），不是实测；部分子模型为假设。
footnote.en: Numbers from uncalibrated numerical simulation (48 wind cases, one intermediate rider profile), not measurements; some sub-models are assumed.

items.zh: 可用画面约 48%，目标 ≥80%；顺风时约 20%，顺风超过约 5 m/s 不放飞
items.en: Usable footage ≈48% vs a ≥80% target; ≈20% in tailwinds, no flight in tailwinds above ≈5 m/s

items.zh: 顺风或强侧风时线在头部 1 m 以内最多约占滑行的 21%（目标 ≤5%）
items.en: In tailwinds or strong crosswinds the line is within 1 m of the head for up to ≈21% of riding (target ≤5%)

items.zh: 多数停下时在雪面待机，而不是回到背上；收工需手动拿起
items.en: At most stops it parks on the snow rather than re-docking; pick it up by hand at the end

items.zh: 风筝在身后雪面待机时，线和风筝可能被后方滑雪者压到或绊到；雪面再起飞未经验证
items.en: While parked on the snow behind you, the kite and line can be skied over or tripped on by others; relaunching from the snow is unverified

items.zh: 约 55% 的飞行时间线低悬在骑手身后（他人可能被绊）
items.en: The line runs low behind the rider for ≈55% of airborne time (others can trip)

items.zh: 共同指标里的收纳体积按展开平放在背上计算为约 20 L（用户已接受不折叠）
items.en: Packed volume on the shared rule is ≈20 L as carried open and flat (the user accepted not folding it)

items.zh: 不可转向：拍摄角度固定（用户已接受）
items.en: Not steerable: fixed filming angle (accepted by the user)

items.zh: 13 项共同指标中仿真达标 8 项
items.en: 8 of 13 shared criteria pass in simulation

items.zh: 尚未做任何实物与雪场试验
items.en: No physical or on-snow tests yet

sub.zh: 设计目标：背着走，滑起来就飞，停下就待命
sub.en: The goal: wear it, ski, and it flies; stop, and it waits for you.

disclaimer.zh: 概念设计。本片全部画面为计算机仿真渲染，不是实拍；性能数字来自未经标定的仿真，尚未进行任何实物试验。13 项判定指标中仿真达标 8 项，尚不是可用设计。
disclaimer.en: Concept design. Every frame is a computer-simulated render, not real footage. Performance numbers come from uncalibrated simulation; no physical tests have been run. It meets 8 of 13 criteria in simulation and is not yet a usable design.

title.zh: 背包来放风筝；拍摄角度固定
title.en: The pack flies the kite; the filming angle is fixed

sub.zh: 风筝偏到侧面时，背包稍微收线直到它回正（防摆，不是转向）
sub.en: If the kite drifts to the side, the pack reels in a little until it recentres (swing guard — not steering)

mouth.zh: 出线环：主线 + 泄力线

mainMid.zh: 主线：按相对风放长、收短
mainMid.en: Main line: lengthened or shortened with the apparent wind

depMid.zh: 泄力线：调迎角，控制拉力
depMid.en: Depower line: trims angle of attack to hold the pull

kite.zh: 风筝上没有电机、没有螺旋桨
kite.en: No motor, no propeller on the kite

title.zh: 停下后：在身后雪面待机，出发时再起飞
title.en: Stopped: it waits on the snow behind you and relaunches

sub.zh: 通常在身后约 2.5 m 的雪面待机，下次蹬出时设计上从雪面再起飞（未验证）
sub.en: Usually it parks ≈2.5 m behind on the snow and is designed to relaunch from there when you push off (unverified)

tag.zh: 设想中的其他用途 · 未经仿真评估
tag.en: Other possible uses · not simulated or evaluated

rules.zh: 需遵守当地道路与空域规定；图示为封闭场地、海滩或水面，不在公共道路上
rules.en: Local road and airspace rules apply; shown on closed tracks, beaches or open water, not public roads
